integrity: Every all-n statement follows from an explicit 4x4 transfer matrix, exact determinant identity and Perron-root derivative. Exact physical-energy enumeration and symbolic algebra independently test the premises; no independent scientific audit.
limitations: Classical unit-coupling, zero-field Ising spins on the 3n-vertex line graph of C_n square K_2, n>=3. The finite-temperature derivative is taken before the n limit. No transverse quantum susceptibility or added couplings. Historical priority depends on examined material.
title: Exact zero-field magnetization and Curie response of the prism-line Ising antiferromagnet
